cover_letter.greeting: Dear Morgan Stanley Firm Strategy and Execution Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Analyst role on Morgan Stanley's Firm Strategy and Execution team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is that it looks across the whole firm, from market and competitor assessments to where to grow next, and turns that into material senior management and the Board actually use.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I benchmarked historical marketing-channel budget allocations against peers and found 30% efficiency gains to guide reinvestment, and I prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership on capital allocation and planning. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. In my MBA coursework I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, a DCF and an LBO, and looked at packaged food M&A in Capital IQ.
That combination of analysis, modeling and clear executive communication is what I'd bring to the team's strategy work. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Analyst, Firm Strategy and Execution role at Morgan Stanley. At JPMorgan Asset Management I benchmarked marketing-channel budget allocations against peers and found 30% efficiency gains, and I prepared briefs for senior leadership. I'd love to hear how the team picks its projects. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
